title: Sponsored pitch for Framer Agents: an AI agent inside Framer that edits design, CMS, styles and SEO on the live site, plus 'branching' for team edits; argues maintenance (53% of work) beats one-prompt prototypes

tools.name: Framer Agents
tools.detail: AI agent inside Framer editor; 'now live on framer.com' (creator says 'frame.com')

tools.name: Framer branching
tools.detail: Team feature: separate branches, compare versions, publish without breaking live site

tools.name: Framer creator community
tools.detail: Share work, build reputation, earn money (templates/experts marketplace)

claims: 53% of the actual website work is maintenance and constant updates
Perplexity built its site in Framer without developers; Zapier shipped a full website in one week
Framer Agents generate ideas, design components, CMS content, styles and SEO settings in real time inside the editor
how_to_steps: Open the Agent panel inside the Framer editor (tabs 'Agent' / 'Style', 'New Chat', 'Ask agents...')
Describe changes; the agent edits components, CMS content, styles or SEO directly on the site
Use branching for team members to make changes, compare versions and publish
Publish and keep updating from the same place (no export/hosting step)
on_screen_only: Framer agent UI: tabs 'Agent' | 'Style', 'New Chat', input 'Ask agents...'
Demo site 'HAUS' with nav items MERIDIAN, NORTE, FENIX, VELDT, FORMA (mobile preview)
A generated landing page: 'YOUR POCKET GUIDE TO SURVIVING PARENTHOOD, ONE ACTIVITY AT A TIME'
Zapier homepage screenshot: 'The platform and partner that make AI work in the real world'
Framer Experts/community profile cards (e.g. 'Ulvin', 'Framer Pro Expert', 'Product Designer')

relevance.why: Haji builds apps with Claude Code, not marketing sites in a no-code tool; Framer lock-in conflicts with the ownership stance in his liked Supabase/Vercel videos. The maintenance point is valid but generic.

implement_score.why: Only worth it if a marketing/landing site should live outside the codebase for non-dev editing. Otherwise Claude Code + a React landing page already liked (Impeccable, awesome-design) covers it.

verify: Is this a paid Framer partnership (likely; Framer community plug)?
Framer Agents pricing tier and whether agent edits count against a credit quota
Source of the '53% of work is maintenance' statistic

gap.what: Mostly a sponsored no-code pitch; liked set already has multiple site-builder promos (Readdy, Manus) and better code-owned design skills. Only new nugget: Framer now has an in-editor agent and branching.
